👀 Navy ships are rolling into Houston for something the state has never seen before: its first-ever Fleet Week.

Crowds packed Seawolf Park to catch a glimpse of visiting warships as Fleet Week Houston officially began. The event will bring multiple activities and ship tours to the region over the next several days. | Chron | Facebook
